event_house_field_preparation_801bb2e938.basis_goal: Prepare Tang Wei's personal forces and household support for Qin field service without inventing stock, manufacturing or child training

delivery.route: House Tang family and quartermaster report

event_house_field_preparation_801bb2e938.summary: Tang Champions receive 48000 kg food, 240000 kg fodder and 522000 additional war arrows; 2000 exact spare equipment items are transferred from House armory reserve into formation staging custody. House Guard receive 288000 kg food, 0 kg fodder and 3132000 additional war arrows; 9000 exact spare equipment items are transferred from House armory reserve into formation staging custody. The registered departure reserve is fully issued from existing House stock. Tang Kai remains at Tang Manor under the already-persisted age-appropriate training disposition. No replacement mounts are issued by this standing field-service package unless Tang Wei separately orders remounts. House Tang's armory and remount workshops are now registered against 7000 forge/armory workers and 5000 stable/remount workers. Their monthly output is resource-bounded by nearby material or horse stock, House silver, and reserve-target shortfalls; the report therefore distinguishes exact current stock from future replenishment instead of inventing instant production.

event_household_response_221646fe94f55f0.basis_goal: House Tang response to Tang Wei's established household request
event_household_response_221646fe94f55f0.summary: Sword Manor admits 60 screened Initiates into existing vacancies. Their training remains on the normal Sword Manor cycle.

event_qin_command_receiver_ready_85bc97e.basis_goal: Receive Tang Wei's already-authorized report for an accepted Qin field command

delivery.route: Qin Military Bureau receiving authority at the saved report site

event_qin_command_receiver_ready_85bc97e.summary: At the saved Qin reporting site, the Qin Military Bureau receiving authority accepts Tang Wei's already-declared report for his pending field command. A lawful receiver and assumption process are now established. This handoff does not itself transfer command authority, troop custody, ownership, deployment authority, or manpower.

event_story_family_invitation_c92fc7096c.summary: A household messenger brings a personal note from Tang Zhu. Tang Zhu asks you to come to the family hall to discuss House military readiness and your own command prospects. It is an invitation rather than a command or automatic scene transition; Tang Wei may answer it, postpone it, or continue with other duties.

event_story_qin_command_assumed_223a49b1.basis_goal: Assume an already-accepted Qin field command at its exact registered report location
event_story_qin_command_assumed_223a49b1.summary: Tang Wei reports through the lawful Qin receiving authority at loc_qin_eastern_depot and formally assumes the Qin field command already accepted. Higher command authority now covers four persistent 2,000-man Qin Border Detachment units totaling 8,000 fighting troops. Each unit keeps its own exact commander and deputy; administrative ownership and manpower provenance remain Qin's. The appointment does not itself move the units, choose a march route, battle plan, sovereign allegiance, or permanent strategy.
